caption: The drawing depicts a single standing human figure positioned centrally against a plain, light-colored background. The figure has brown skin and shoulder-length dark brown hair. On the head, the figure wears a yellow headband with three green feathers attached vertically. The figure is dressed in a light pink short-sleeved shirt, a broad green and yellow necklace, and a green skirt or kilt with a green fringe at the bottom. Around the waist is a wide yellow belt that is tied in a bow on the left side. The legs are bare below the skirt, and the figure wears tan shoes. The right forearm and hand appear to be wrapped or gloved in a brown covering, while the left hand is bare and held up in front of the chest. The background is a plain off-white with no added objects or scenery.
title: Cigar Store Indian
